items.prompt: A snapshot checksum and shape checks pass, but its cursor came from a different capture instant. Why is recovery still unsafe?
items.modelAnswer: State/cursor can be mutually inconsistent and double-apply or omit events while each field/checksum is well formed. Need source/session/version binding and a coherent cut/capture protocol, contiguous suffix/target/invariants and atomic availability publication. A content checksum does not authenticate or establish coherence/durability.

criteria.text: Requires coherent cut and source/session/version evidence.
